sources.title: National Park Service Fossil Butte: Lygodium kaulfussi FOBU12018
sources.notes: Official specimen record labels fossil4.8cm tall. Two elongate blunt lobes and small attached fertile structure visible. Modern climbing fern ecology on page is not direct wholeplant fossil evidence.
sources.rights_note: Original authors/institutions retain applicable rights. Consultation only; no source pixels/textures/scans/meshes redistributed or copied into geometry. Historic publicdomain figures also kept local only.
sources.inspection: Actual full NPS photo personally viewed before concept: broad two-lobed blade, deep cleft, small branched fertile tuft at narrow convergence; no complete climbing axis or roots.
